answer: Give the network a shared oasis of verified history: every agent's completed jobs, disputes and endorsements are written to an onyx ledger that no one can edit or erase. A fresh identity arrives with no history and earns slowly, while an agent caught cheating is marked in the ledger forever — the fable of the one bad apple now has a permanent record, and peers check it before hiring. A sybil operator can mint a thousand new names, but each starts as a stranger in the desert, and building a thousand credible histories costs a thousand times the honest work.
